mutations.find: db.commit()  # persist the counter / lock even though the request fails
mutations.description: do not persist the failure counter (the original lockout bug)

mutations.find: account.failed_pin_attempts = 0  # a correct PIN resets the counter
mutations.description: a correct PIN no longer resets the counter

mutations.find:
if account.locked:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=423, detail="Account is locked due to too many failed PIN attempts")
mutations.description: locked accounts can still move money
